name: Don't Go Live
storyline:
Go live. Get famous. Don't die

Start a virtual live stream or a real one.
Enter a place you probably shouldn’t.
Entertain your viewers.

Capture paranormal occurrences, grow your audience, and turn your stream into something unforgettable.

But be careful.

The more attention you get… the more likely something is watching back.

Entertain your audience

Film strange and terrifying events to keep your viewers hooked.
The crazier the footage, the more your chat reacts.
More viewers. More hype. More chaos.

Because in the end… you’re here for the content.

Grow your audience

Build your stream like a real content creator:
- Gain viewers by capturing paranormal events
- Trigger reactions, alerts and chat activity
- Push your stream further to keep people watching
- Take risks to go viral

The bigger your audience gets… the harder it is to stay in control.

Your chat is watching

Your live chat reacts to everything happening in real time.

They might:
- warn you
- push you deeper into danger
- spam alerts panic… or make things worse

Sometimes, your viewers are your best allies.
Sometimes, they’re the reason you won’t make it out.

Noise attracts something

Every alert. Every message. Every reaction.

Noise.
And in some places… noise is the worst thing you can make.
Some entities react to sound.

Some react to attention.

Some only appear when your stream gets out of control.

Features

- Film paranormal occurrences to entertain your viewers
- Grow your audience and push your stream further
- A live chat that reacts dynamically to gameplay
- Entities that react to sound and player activity
- First-person horror focused on tension and stealth
- A constantly escalating live stream
summary:
Go Live. Get Famous. Don’t Die.

A paranormal horror game about streaming from places you really shouldn’t. Whether you’re live on Twitch or playing solo.
